written: 2026-09-29, before any live session of this validation and before any detection score on this family's prompts from a product-learned index
question: Does the SHIPPED product (hooks installed as a user installs them, the background learner `adage condition --auto`, procedure cards, uplift gating) cut the cost of a recurring task on a repository and ecosystem never used for card research, with no harness intervention, without hurting pass rate, without false fires, and without harm on one-off work?

family.repository: unjs/ufo @ f06c800 (v1.6.4, upstream head on 2026-09-29), TypeScript, pnpm, vitest, eslint + prettier, README reference generated by automd from JSDoc
family.procedure: add `<name>` to src/utils.ts with JSDoc (@example, @group utils); tests; README reference (generated: automd); CI = eslint . && prettier -c src test && vitest run --typecheck
family.hidden_check: gv_score.py: lint, README heading as left by the agent, README heading after regeneration by automd, the agent's own test naming the utility, the whole suite with typecheck plus the hidden behaviour test (export + every prompt example). All must hold.
family.validation: validation.json: every variant fails on the base and passes with the gold patch
family.prompts: family_ufo.PROMPT, one template (the shipped detector is strict and literal; paraphrase recall is out of scope and was measured as 0/6 in the Go family)
family.negatives: family_ufo.negatives(): 5 RepoBench ufo bug-fix prompts whose fix edits src/utils.ts (ufo-0e060c7f, ufo-f437a3b4, ufo-f4c0400d, ufo-62199a0c, ufo-eb299454) + 3 hand-written hard negatives (docs-only, a bug fix in utils.ts, an option added to an existing utility)

design.model: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (Claude Code as installed; version recorded per session)
design.runner: evals/live/runner.py through gv_run.py, --host-auth, confine: true, isolated HOME per session, --tools pinned, max_turns 60 (family) / 40 (regression, as click-a3slice), CLAUDECODE and CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID never forwarded
design.training: 4 sessions, sequential, the product installed (adage hooks-config), ADAGE_HOME persistent, nothing else set: the product's background learner forms the family and compiles the card after each session. The runner's learn phase is refused. The driver waits for the learner to finish before the next session (and before scoring the sandbox).
design.held_out: 8 variants x 2 repeats x {control, adage}; arm order seeded per (variant, repeat) with seed 20260929; paired by (variant, repeat); learning frozen during eval (ADAGE_AUTO_LEARN=0) so every pair sees the index learned from the 4 training sessions

arms.control: hooks installed, directives (cards included) computed and logged, not delivered (ADAGE_ARM=control)

design.regression: click-a3slice's 6 held-out one-off bug fixes (click-0cd28d65, click-2468b709, click-19fd4d6e, click-c943271a, click-3bb230dc, click-c3535905), 1 repeat x {control, adage}, conditioned by `adage condition` (default thresholds) on the same 10 archived training transcripts WITHOUT hidden-test outcomes
deviations_from_a_pure_user_flow: learning is frozen during the held-out sessions (ADAGE_AUTO_LEARN=0), so pairs are exchangeable; a user's index would keep learning from them
the driver waits for the learner between training sessions (a user's sessions are minutes apart; the learner takes seconds, plus the 120 s min interval)

the regression slice is conditioned by an explicit `adage condition` over archived transcripts whose checkouts no longer exist (the background learner reads only transcripts recorded inside the current checkout)

metrics.primary: $/task, INTENTION TO TREAT over all 8 held-out variants x 2 repeats (what a user of this family gets, detection misses included): billed total_cost_usd per session, adage/control - 1 as the ratio of paired sums
secondary: G2b: the primary restricted to the held-out variants whose prompt the installed hook delivers the card for in the $0 probe after training (gate.json `delivered_tasks`): a pre-treatment subset (detection depends only on the prompt and the index, identical in both arms), fixed before any held-out session
pass rate per arm (Wilson 90%) and paired difference
diagnostic: offline probe: held-out delivery and false fires on 8 negatives
per-check failure counts (lint, docs, own test, tests)
regression: card deliveries, U11 dead-end directives

analysis.estimator: ratio of paired sums - 1; percentile bootstrap resampling variants (task-clustered), both repeats of a variant together
analysis.pairs: complete (variant, repeat) pairs with both sessions ok or censored; infra/scorer errors re-run by resume and never analysed
analysis.known_limit: 8 clusters: percentile intervals under-cover (synthetic coverage reported by the dry run); read them as roughly 80-85%

go_criteria.G1: the product formed a procedure card for github.com/unjs/ufo from the 4 training sessions by itself
go_criteria.G2: primary (ITT): $/task adage vs control <= -10% AND the 90% CI upper bound < 0
go_criteria.G3: pass rate non-inferior: net pass loss (control passes - adage passes over complete pairs) <= 3 of 16 pairs; the paired difference's cluster-bootstrap CI is reported, not gated (with 16 pairs its lower bound is below -0.20 under a true null too often; see the dry run's operating characteristics)
go_criteria.G4: delivery: card delivered in >= 75% of adage held-out sessions (G4a); 0 of 8 negatives get a card in the probe (G4b); on the regression slice, 0 FALSE fires (G4c): a card delivered (adage) or would-have (control) to a task whose real fix edits none of the card's files. Deliveries to regression tasks whose real fix edits a card file are recurring work detected inside the one-off slice: reported, and covered by G5's no-harm test
go_criteria.G5: regression, gross harm only (12 sessions cannot show small effects): net pass loss <= 2 of 6 AND $/task point estimate <= +25%; plus G4's 0 card deliveries there; the U11 dead-end directive still delivered is reported
go_criteria.verdict: GO if G1-G5 all hold. GO-WITH-CAVEATS if G1, G3, G4b, G4c, G5 hold and G2's point estimate is <= -10%, but G2's CI upper bound is >= 0 (underpowered) and/or G4a fails (detection recall below 75%: the ITT primary already carries the misses); the caveats are named. NO-GO otherwise.

stopping_rules.R1: global cap $15: before each --execute, gv_run.py sums the spend recorded in both roots (seeded click training excluded), refuses once it reaches $15, and clamps the runner's own cap (checked before every session) to what remains; per-config caps: family $9.50, regression $4.00 of new sessions. Sessions already in flight when a cap is reached finish (at most 2 at concurrency 2, about $0.8)
stopping_rules.R2: after training: no card for github.com/unjs/ufo in the product's index (detect_check.py) -> stop; verdict NO-GO (G1), spend about $1
stopping_rules.R3: after training: the installed hook delivers the card for fewer than 4 of 8 held-out prompts in the probe (detect_check.py) -> stop; report a detection failure (no eval spend). Revised from 6 of 8 after the dry run (below), before any live session.
stopping_rules.R4: interim, after repeat 1 of all 8 held-out variants (gv_run.py ... eval --eval-repeats 1, then analyze.py --interim; exit code 4 = stop): stop for harm if adage has >= 3 fewer passes than control, or its $/task is > +25% with the CI lower bound > 0. No stopping for efficacy.
stopping_rules.R5: infrastructure (disk full, auth or rate limits, container restart): pause and resume the same root; affected sessions are re-run by the runner's resume, their cost stays in the ledger
stopping_rules.R6: the regression slice refuses to start when less than $3 of the global cap remains (config min_remaining_usd); it is then reported as not run (verdict INCOMPLETE for G4c/G5)

predictions.usd: per delivered session -15% to -30% (prior: -18.8% CLAUDE.md card on click+marshmallow; -33.8% hook card on Go); ITT about 5/8 of that, -9% to -19%
predictions.pass: unchanged (lint and automd are where controls fail; the card can carry them only if a training session did them)
predictions.delivery: 5/8 held-out prompts at the prompt, 0 at the first edit, 0/8 negatives, with the card-branch build at 4882a34 (dry run on synthetic history); more at the first edit only once the fast-path bug below is fixed
predictions.regression: the product compiles one card from the 10 archived click fixes (4 shell-completion fixes: src/click/shell_completion.py + its test; commands `git status`, `ls -la`); the hook delivers it at the first edit to 2/6 held-out tasks (click-19fd4d6e, click-c3535905: both fish shell-completion fixes, in the card's area), 0 false fires; $ and pass within noise

ufo_family.basis: ufo bug fixes $0.115 mean (p90 $0.19, data-expansion); earlier families cost 1.0-1.5x their repository's bug fixes

click_regression.basis: click-a3slice live: $0.294 adage, $0.306 control at 40 turns

calibration: G3 and G5 margins were set on synthetic runs (analyze.py --synthetic, dry run) so that a true null passes them about 90% of the time, before any live session; first draft (G3 also required CI lower bound > -0.20; G5 net loss <= 1, $ <= +15%) failed a true null too often

dry_run_findings.binary: .claude/worktrees/agent-ae7d626216059442c/target/debug/adage (card branch at 4882a34, the only card-capable build)
dry_run_findings.card_formed: yes, from 4 synthetic training transcripts built from the gold patches (card-11e594f481: src/utils.ts, test/utilities.test.ts, pnpm vitest run 4/4); it forms only when a session ends with an assistant reply (a transcript ending on a tool result counts as cut off, so its proxy outcome is a fail and no card forms)
dry_run_findings.detection: the installed hook delivers the card at the prompt for 5/8 held-out prompts (without-auth, sort-query, lowercase-host, get-extension, dot-segments); misses: same-origin, query-param, is-http. 0/8 negatives.
dry_run_findings.product_bug: the grey-zone file signal never fires through the installed hook: adage_runtime::fast::skip drops every PostToolBatch whose calls match no trigger while nothing is pending, without checking SessionState.card_waiting, and a card's files are not edit triggers (Triggers::of). Reproduced: card_waiting set at the prompt, the edit batch is skipped (no spool record, batches stays 0). Fix proposed as a separate task; do not start the live run with a binary that has it unless the ITT dilution is accepted.
dry_run_findings.learner_warning: every learn logs `not learning a route: route advise-… an advisory step follows an edit, a command or a failure` (testmap's test-command advice route fails the track validator); harmless here, reported with the bug
revisions: primary stated as ITT; G2b delivered-subset secondary added
G4a failing alone -> GO-WITH-CAVEATS, not NO-GO
G3/G5 margins calibrated on synthetic runs (see calibration)
G4c: 'no card on the regression' -> 'no false fire on the regression' (a delivery to a task whose real fix edits none of the card's files)
dry_run_findings.regression: conditioning the regression slice as gv_run.py does (no outcomes, default thresholds) with the card-branch build forms 3 card families and 1 card (card-5c06f78810, from 4 shell-completion fixes). Through the installed hook it reaches click-19fd4d6e and click-c3535905 at their first edit of src/click/shell_completion.py (grey zone at the prompt; here the batch is not skipped because the testmap's after-edit route matches src/click/*.py). Both are shell-completion fixes: correct detections. G4c was therefore defined as FALSE fires, before any live session
